chaccevime.l: sataṁ sattati chaccevime honti ubhinnaṁ asādhāraṇā
chaccevime.g: bhikkhūnaṁ bhikkhunīhi asādhāraṇā chacattārīsa, bhikkhunīnaṁ bhikkhūhi asādhāraṇā tiṁsādhikaṁ satañcāti1 evaṁ ubhinnaṁ asādhāraṇā ca chasattati-adhikaṁ sataṁ sikkhāpadānīti attho.

chaccā.g: dasa ca cha ca soḷasa kāḷarājiyo.
